# typora paper source

- Source: <https://github.com/lisitan/esther-obsidian-typora-themes>
- Pinned commit: `8c4f912738228ec6a57e38a582219cee1174b47c`
- Upstream files: `typora/esther-inspired-paper.css` and `typora/esther/esther-base.css` (directory structure preserved)

The files in this directory are unmodified source snapshots. WeiSome adapts only the article-content rules to Compose preview styles and inline HTML export. Typora application chrome, page background, fonts, math, table of contents, and editor-only interaction rules are not applied.
